_comment: Requirements that enumerate a set of members. ODP-SA-06 has no per-requirement acceptance criteria -- its Trigger and Acceptance columns are the same boilerplate seventy-one times -- so nothing said whether the eighth constraint class or the fifth release mode was required. This file is the narrow substitute: for requirements that list N things, the N things are written down, each satisfied member names where it lives, and each absent member carries an auditable disposition. Adding a requirement here is cheap; leaving a gap unwritten or claiming an unverified decision is what the check refuses.

_source_provenance.policy: Repo transcriptions and amendments are not canonical sources. A canonical record requires a version, exact location, and SHA-256 of the source bytes; unavailable authority remains BLOCKED_BY_EVIDENCE.

canonical_source.blocked_reason: Neither expected path exists at the pinned ref; the repository amendment only declares amends and does not contain the original artifact.

repo_transcription.scope: Cause 02 and Appendix A summarize ODP-SA-06 but are repo evidence, not the canonical specification.

ODP-SA-06.recheck: Obtain the original artifact or immutable source ref from Product/source custodian, then record version, exact location, and SHA-256.

canonical_source.blocked_reason: No standalone requirement artifact or source row with verifiable version, location, and bytes was found; the repo contains only an AVM-001 summary in the verification report.

repo_transcription.scope: Appendix A AVM-001 row summarizes GM_TTM, GM_FWD, depreciation, asset, lease, and normalization; it is not the full FR text.

ODP-FR-AVM-001.recheck: Confirm whether AVM-001 belongs to the original ODP-SA-06 artifact or a separate canonical AVM document, then hash the retrieved source bytes.

requirements.statement: 系統必須考量資本、租約、施工、設備、人力、覆蓋、稀釋與時序硬限制。

members.name: DILUTION
members.note: A per-catchment cap on OPEN actions. Cannibalisation is pairwise between sites and the model is linear, so this is the part of the effect a count can carry, not the whole effect. DECIDED 2026-09-02: the full pairwise form is not pursued. Linearising it costs O(n^2) auxiliary variables, but the deciding reason is that the pairwise dilution coefficients are themselves model outputs carrying substantial uncertainty -- optimising precisely against uncertain coefficients manufactures precision the inputs do not support. The better next investment is the measurement: ODP-FR-HZ-004 absorption now produces realised dilution figures, and improving those changes the answer more than improving the optimisation over the current ones.

disposition.scope: NetPlan linear solver optimization in ODP core
disposition.reopen_trigger: When pairwise dilution coefficient estimation uncertainty is reduced below optimization sensitivity threshold
disposition.rationale: Catchment count cap implemented and verified; pairwise form formally amended per ODP_REQUIREMENT_DISPOSITIONS.md

members.name: LEASE
members.note: Needs a per-option admissibility check (can this lease be signed or broken in the plan window, and at what penalty). No such data source is wired to the solver. Reported through ConstraintClass.LEASE in unmodelled_constraint_classes on every solve.

disposition.evidence_needed: Per-option lease admissibility and penalty schedule data source verification (Batch 0)
disposition.rationale: Awaiting Batch 0 data source audit before scheduling solver integration or formal waiver.

members.name: SEQUENCING
members.note: Needs a time dimension: per-period resource caps and precedence between actions. ActionOption.period_key is carried and reported but never constrained. DECIDED 2026-09-02: not modelled, and not scheduled. A per-period constraint is only worth having if per-period capacity data exists to feed it, and it does not -- construction and labour capacity are supplied to the solver as single totals. A constraint fed by a figure nobody measures is decorative, which is the pattern this work exists to remove. The risk it would have covered (a plan reported feasible while unschedulable) is already handled by ConstraintClass.SEQUENCING appearing in unmodelled_constraint_classes on every solve. Revisit when a planning cycle needs per-period sequencing AND the per-period capacity figures exist.

disposition.scope: NetPlan linear solver optimization in ODP core
disposition.reopen_trigger: When planning cycle needs per-period sequencing AND per-period capacity figures exist
disposition.rationale: Per-period constraint without per-period capacity data is decorative; reported through unmodelled_constraint_classes

members.name: CHAMPION_CHALLENGER
members.note: Compares champion and challenger predictions against a tolerance and recommends rollback. Note this compares prediction agreement, not metrics against a baseline -- see ODP-FR-LH-005.

members.name: BACKTEST
members.note: run_rolling_backtest exists in models/shared_ml/backtest.py and is used by the training pipeline, but modules/learninghub references it nowhere. It is not a release mode, so a release cannot be gated on a backtest result.

disposition.rationale: Rolling backtest exists in training pipeline but is not connected as a LearningHub release gate (Batch 6).

members.name: ADJUST
members.note: Recommendation is CONTINUE/SCALE/STOP/CHANGE_CHANNEL/INCONCLUSIVE -- AdLift's vocabulary, which satisfies ODP-FR-AD-005 exactly and leaves no place for Adjust. InterventionStatus runs EXECUTING to OBSERVING to EVALUATING to COMPLETED with rollback as the only mid-course exit, so there is no state for 'modify and continue' either.

disposition.rationale: AdLift vocabulary uses Continue/Scale/Stop; lifecycle adjusting state pending business requirement clarification (Batch 6).

requirements.statement: 所有長時間任務都能查詢 QUEUED/RUNNING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELLED/PARTIAL。

members.name: PARTIAL
members.note: JobStatus in shared/governance/vocabularies.py carries PARTIAL per ODP-FR-SHARED-001, but no job in the tree currently reports it. The vocabulary fork between queue.py and listings.py was resolved under ODP-JOBSTATUS-OUTCOME-VS-DELIVERY-001 by separating outcome from delivery mechanics. Producer trace under ODP-JOB-PARTIAL-PRODUCER-EVIDENCE-001 closed the tree-level question against all registered job types. Formal disposition and handback package HB-SHARED001-PARTIAL-001 submitted to Human/Ops, Architecture Board, and Platform Infrastructure Lead per docs/evidence/ODP_JOB_PARTIAL_DISPOSITION_2026-09-03.md.

history.note: Gap registered by the disposition registry: the vocabulary carries PARTIAL, no producer was found.
ODP-JOB-PARTIAL-PRODUCER-EVIDENCE-001 completed producer trace and ODP-JOB-PARTIAL-DISPOSITION-001 established formal disposition and Human-Authority Handback Package (HB-SHARED001-PARTIAL-001).

disposition.evidence_needed: Two things, neither of which the tree can answer. (1) A live production queue/scheduler/worker receipt inventory, to say whether any deployed job has ever reported JobStatus.PARTIAL; the repo trace only establishes that no code path writes it. (2) A product decision on whether the partial-shaped command outcomes that do exist -- batch intake 207 per-row receipts, XLSX partial commit, external ingestion accepted/quarantined counts -- should become durable jobs carrying member-level receipts and a member retry contract.
disposition.reopen_trigger: (1) Production worker registry adds a multi-item batch job handler with reachable JobStatus.PARTIAL transition, OR (2) synchronous command operations (batch intake / external ingestion) are formally scheduled to become durable jobs with itemized receipts and member-level retry contracts, OR (3) live production queue/worker audit receipts demonstrate deployed jobs reporting PARTIAL.
disposition.rationale: JobStatus vocabulary declares PARTIAL but no long-running batch job currently produces partial status (Batch 5b). The producer trace walked the default registry (forecast, external-fetch, assisted-listing-intake) and every module worker entry point and found no PARTIAL write. The partial-shaped outcomes that do exist are synchronous command receipts, not queue jobs; wiring them onto JobStatus to complete the member count would be the fake implementation this gate exists to prevent. Handback package HB-SHARED001-PARTIAL-001 submitted per ODP_JOB_PARTIAL_DISPOSITION_2026-09-03.md.

Production-path conversion hits are Listing-to-Candidate conversion or Evidence Level migration notes. Evidence request ER-SITE001-FORMAT-CONVERSION-001 and formal handback HB-SITE001-FORMAT-CONVERSION-001 submitted per docs/evidence/ODP_SITE001_COMPONENT_DISPOSITIONS_2026-09-03.md.

disposition.evidence_owner: Retail Operations Lead / Site Economics Lead
disposition.rationale: Repo contains only static store format codes and greenfield simulation logic; no format conversion event tracking or remodeling financial model exists in repo. Handback package HB-SITE001-FORMAT-CONVERSION-001 submitted to Human/Ops and Architecture Board for operational playbook confirmation or formal amendment per ODP_SITE001_COMPONENT_DISPOSITIONS_2026-09-03.md.
